punchline: Goggins put his goals on sticky notes on the mirror and told the man in it the truth.
thirty_sec: At 297 pounds and wanting to be a Navy SEAL, David Goggins stuck his goals on Post-it notes on his bathroom mirror. He looked at himself, told himself the truth instead of a softer story, and each night wrote what he had to do next. In the book he lost over a hundred pounds in that period.
